summary: Faz 5-A Askeri Üniforma Kütüphanesi frontend testing — 6/7 assertions PASS. Admin flow (list, upload+instant publish, rename via prompt, delete) 100% working. Studio flow (approved-only list, no admin controls, upload → 'onay bekleniyor' toast, pending persisted in DB) working EXCEPT the request's expectation that uploader sees own pending item with 'Onay bekliyor' badge — backend list_uniforms filters strictly to status='approved' for non-admin, so studio uploader does NOT see own pending in the grid. Regression: size dropdown, digital-download-btn, qr-deliver-btn all render in studio Vesikalik editor.

minor.issue: For non-admin studio accounts, endpoint returns ONLY status='approved' items. Review request expected uploader to also see their OWN pending items (with 'Onay bekliyor' badge). Currently pending items are hidden from the uploader after successful submit. Suggested fix in /app/backend/routers/studio.py list_uniforms: else branch should be {'$or':[{'status':'approved'},{'uploaded_by':acc['id']}], 'is_deleted': {'$ne': True}}

integration_issues.issue: After studio uploads 'Hava Er', toast says 'Üniforma gönderildi — admin onayı bekleniyor' correctly, and record IS created as pending in DB (admin sees it). But studio's own grid does not display it because backend excludes non-approved from non-admin list. UniformLibrary.jsx already has the rendering logic (yellow 'Onay bekliyor' badge) — the gap is on the backend.

action_items: Backend: In /app/backend/routers/studio.py list_uniforms, allow non-admin uploader to also see own pending/rejected items so the 'Onay bekliyor' badge in UniformLibrary.jsx actually surfaces after they submit. Recommended filter for non-admin: {'is_deleted': {'$ne': True}, '$or': [{'status':'approved'}, {'uploaded_by': acc['id']}]}. Note that context_note claimed backend hides pending from studio; if that is the DESIRED behavior, please remove the review-item wording 'appears in their own list' and treat this as passed.
critical_code_review_comments: UniformLibrary.jsx already assumes the API returns own-pending to the uploader (renders 'Onay bekliyor' badge branch). Backend contract does not match — behavioral drift between UI expectation and API filter.

img crossOrigin='anonymous' + credentials:'include' file endpoint: works because cookie is same-site preview domain. If deployed to a different origin, canvas taints/CORS could break. Consider a signed short-lived URL for PNG previews.
doAction uses window.prompt/window.confirm — fine for admin utility but not ideal UX. Consider replacing with a shadcn Dialog on next iteration.
AdminPassportPhoto.jsx still 1200+ lines and now embeds UniformLibrary — split ripe.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Uniform Library UI flows verified against real backend on the preview URL. Only open issue: studio uploader cannot see own pending item — if main agent fixes the backend filter, retest by uploading a studio uniform and asserting uniform-card-<id> with 'Onay bekliyor' text is visible ONLY in the uploader's grid (not in another studio's grid).
rca of the issue: Backend /api/studio/uniforms list_uniforms (studio.py:1132-1138) filters non-admin queries with {'status':'approved'} only. There is no OR clause for uploaded_by == current studio id. Consequently, after a studio POSTs a new uniform (status='pending'), the follow-up GET on the same panel returns the item-set without their pending submission, and UniformLibrary.jsx's 'Onay bekliyor' badge branch never gets exercised in the studio panel. Fix is a one-line change to the else branch of that function.
